sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role fur WHERE fur.user_id = u.user_id AND fur.role_code = #{criteria.roleCode} AND fur.status = 'ACTIVE')

mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.employee_no, p.name, p.organization_code, p.position, p.employment_status, p.duty, p.retirement_date, p.last_synced_at, u.system_enabled, COALESCE(string_agg(ur.role_code, ',' ORDER BY ur.role_code) FILTER (WHERE ur.status = 'ACTIVE'), '') AS role_codes FROM user_account u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshot p ON p.employee_no = u.employee_no LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY u.user_id, p.employee_no, p.name, p.organization_code, p.position, p.employment_status, p.duty, p.retirement_date, p.last_synced_at, u.system_enabled ORDER BY p.employee_no LIMIT #{criteria.size} OFFSET #{criteria.page} * #{criteria.size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshot p ON p.employee_no = u.employee_no WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT u.user_id, u.employee_no, p.name, p.organization_code, p.position, p.employment_status, p.duty, p.retirement_date, p.last_synced_at, u.system_enabled, COALESCE(string_agg(ur.role_code, ',' ORDER BY ur.role_code) FILTER (WHERE ur.status = 'ACTIVE'), '') AS role_codes FROM user_account u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshot p ON p.employee_no = u.employee_no LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, p.employee_no, p.name, p.organization_code, p.position, p.employment_status, p.duty, p.retirement_date, p.last_synced_at, u.system_enabled
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET system_enabled = #{systemEnabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_role SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role WHERE use_status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_code IN #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role (user_role_id, user_id, role_code, assignment_type, approver_user_id, reason, status) VALUES (#{userRoleId}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'MANUAL', #{actorUserId}, #{reason}, 'ACTIVE')
